_comment: Single source of truth for press coverage. Edit this file, then run: python build-press.py

_fields.url: required - direct link to the article
_fields.headline: required - the article's actual headline, verbatim
_fields.date: required - YYYY-MM-DD if the exact day is known, YYYY-MM if only the month is
_fields.author: optional - byline, omit or null if unknown
_fields.lang: optional - BCP47 code, defaults to en
_fields.accent: optional - hex dot colour, defaults to #b967ff
_fields.type: optional - schema.org type, NewsArticle (default) or SocialMediaPosting
_fields.headline_en: optional - English translation shown on the page when headline is not English. headline itself stays verbatim
_fields.group: optional - whole number, default 0. Lower groups sit higher on the page, newest-first within each group

articles.headline: Nya's “99 Problems” captures the beautiful chaos of sleepless nights
articles.description: A review calling “99 Problems” unpredictable, emotionally honest and intentionally overwhelming, praising the German/English switching for feeling like natural rhythm rather than a gimmick, and the hyperpop production for prioritizing emotional overload over shiny perfection.

articles.headline: Kickdrum's Must-Hears: Top 20 Tips
articles.description: The German music magazine Kickdrum picked “Denk Wieder an Dich” for its Top 20 Tips roundup on Instagram, listing Nya among that round's must-hears next to Motionless In White, Lil Baby, Syd and Steve Lacy.

articles.headline: 7 Tage - 7 Songs shares “Denk Wieder an Dich”
articles.description: The German music and talk podcast 7 Tage - 7 Songs picked up “Denk Wieder an Dich” and shared it with its listeners.

articles.headline: Nya channels sleepless creativity in latest “Sweet Monster Energy”
articles.description: A single review calling the track a fearless, restless piece of experimental hyperpop, with German and English traded mid-verse and every sonic twist deliberate enough that the chaos reads as measured rather than messy.
articles.author: Harper Jacobs

articles.headline: Nya, Raploard y Ws Cerve: comienzos y nuevas perspectivas
articles.headline_en: Nya, Raploard and Ws Cerve: beginnings and new perspectives
articles.description: Spanish-language new-music roundup on “Duality2” and “99 Problems”, reading them as two sides of one artistic world: one song digging into internal contrasts and the search for balance, the other going straight at a harder, more defiant energy.
articles.author: Ara CorIza

articles.headline: Indie, electrónica y rap metal: lanzamientos para descubrir
articles.headline_en: Indie, electronica and rap metal: releases to discover
articles.description: Spanish-language roundup of independent releases worth discovering, covering “99 Problems” with Mhhh7887 and vain. Reads the track as rap metal and electronica turned into a vehicle for the emotional wear of an overstimulated generation, placing the production near beastboy, 100 gecs and t-low.
articles.author: Miguel Castillo

articles.headline: Nya, RHYMI y Big Romo muestran tres formas de entender la música urbana actual
articles.headline_en: Nya, RHYMI and Big Romo show three ways of understanding urban music today
articles.description: Spanish-language feature placing Nya alongside RHYMI and Big Romo as three separate answers to what urban music sounds like now. Nya's is the glitchy, bilingual, late-night one.
articles.author: Ara CorIza

articles.headline: MIKEY, Nya y yung baker: emociones digitales entre alt pop y honestidad juvenil
articles.headline_en: MIKEY, Nya and yung baker: digital emotions between alt pop and youthful honesty
articles.description: Spanish-language feature on alt-pop and emotional honesty, covering the glitch production and the German/English switching behind “Denk Wieder an Dich” and “Messer.”
articles.author: Ara CorIza
